content.tagline: Dermocosmetics for problem skin, from breakouts to enlarged pores
content.descriptor: CELLAHEAL is a Korean dermocosmetic brand by ESTC INTERNATIONAL: nine products in two lines, for breakout-prone skin and for enlarged pores
about: CELLAHEAL is a dermocosmetic brand by the Korean company ESTC INTERNATIONAL, founded in 2024. The brand builds its care around the main skin concern at each age. The SPOTLESS line is designed for breakout-prone skin, which is most common between the ages of 10 and 20. The PORELESS line addresses enlarged pores and excess sebum, a concern for ages 20 to 30. For March 2027 the brand has announced a third line, TIMELESS, for signs of aging.

The range currently includes nine products. SPOTLESS comprises a body wash, body mist and body lotion, a cleansing foam, a toner and a serum. They are built on Salvia Leaf Water and gentle exfoliation with four acids: AHA, BHA, PHA and LHA. PORELESS comprises a gel cleanser, a serum and a cream with the proprietary PORE LASER™ complex and apricot-derived PDRN.

The products have undergone dermatological testing and sensitive-skin testing. The body wash formula is protected by Korean patent KR 10-2991658. The full line is registered in the European CPNP system, and some products are also registered under the US FDA MoCRA. CELLAHEAL is sold in Korean pharmacies on pharmacists' recommendation, and on Naver Shopping and Qoo10.

lines.name: SPOTLESS LINE
lines.note: For breakout-prone skin. Six products for face and body: body wash, body mist and body lotion, cleansing foam, toner and serum. Built on Salvia Leaf Water and four acids: AHA · BHA · PHA · LHA.

lines.name: PORELESS LINE
lines.note: For enlarged pores and excess sebum. A gel cleanser, serum and cream with the PORE LASER™ complex (10,000 ppm) and apricot-derived PDRN.

tech.name: SPOTLESS COMPLEX™
tech.note: The proprietary complex of the SPOTLESS line: apple and birch bark extracts and two ferments, Saccharomyces/Coix Seed and Lactobacillus/Pomegranate. Hydrates and softens the skin after cleansing.

tech.name: PORE LASER™
tech.note: The proprietary complex of the PORELESS line, 10,000 ppm: extracts of green tea, yuzu, neem and water lily for pore and sebum care.

tech.name: 4HA System
tech.note: Gentle exfoliation with four acids: AHA, BHA, PHA and LHA. Included in all six SPOTLESS products.

catalog_notes: A body wash for breakout-prone skin: four acids AHA · BHA · PHA · LHA, 26.4% Salvia Leaf Water and the proprietary SPOTLESS COMPLEX™ for hydration after the shower. The formula is protected by patent KR 10-2991658. 500 mL.
A light, alcohol-free body mist: 44.1% Salvia Leaf Water, 2% niacinamide and 10 types of hyaluronic acid to even out skin tone and hydrate the body every day. 150 mL.
A fast-absorbing body lotion that completes the SPOTLESS routine: 40% Salvia Leaf Water, 2% niacinamide, 8 types of hyaluronic acid and panthenol. 300 mL.
A cleansing foam for breakout-prone skin with 0.5% salicylic acid. In the brand's test it removed 99.4% of fine dust in a single wash. 150 mL.
A watery facial toner with 43.12% Salvia Leaf Water, 2% niacinamide and multi-acid exfoliation — the hydration and tone-care step of the SPOTLESS routine. 200 mL.
An intensive serum closing out the SPOTLESS facial routine: 56.35% Salvia Leaf Water, 2% niacinamide, 2% panthenol and a ceramide complex for the skin barrier. 30 mL.
A gel-to-foam cleanser for pores and excess sebum with the PORE LASER™ complex (10,000 ppm), apricot-derived PDRN and fine apricot seed powder for gentle exfoliation. 150 mL.
A dual-function serum with PORE LASER™ (10,000 ppm), 2% niacinamide, 400 ppm adenosine, apricot-derived PDRN and a 17-amino-acid complex. 50 mL.
A cream with PORE LASER™ (10,000 ppm), 2% niacinamide, apricot-derived PDRN and the SLLS complex for barrier support. 60 mL.
